parse_coco_annotation: parse raw COCO annotation data and map AIC keypoints to Goliath3D skeleton format
create_dataset_instance: create an Aic2Goliath3dDataset instance to load and process AIC to Goliath3D pose data
map_keypoint_skeletons: map source AIC dataset keypoints to target Goliath3D skeleton joint indices
review_parse_data_info: review the parse_data_info method that filters invalid instances and transforms bounding boxes
build_dataset_loader: build a dataset loader using Aic2Goliath3dDataset for 3D pose estimation with COCO annotations
